g.title: J_OBC_ACC
g.text: Samtec TFM-105 right-angle (was FTSH-105), SFSDT socket
OBC J9, -X edge, y -24 ... -34: PA13, PA14, NRST, PD8, PD9, PB8, TPS3850 SET0

g.title: W8A
g.text: internal, flown; down the (-X, -Y) bundle, the (-X, -Y) corner strip and flat along the -Y shear panel outboard of the (-40, -43) column

g.title: A3
g.text: access-port board A3, Micro-D 21 socket receptacle (MIL-DTL-83513 class), gold
-Y window at (-20, -50, -43), envelope 30 x 7 x 8.8 mm (CAD request); W8A and W11 soldered to A3

g.title: W8B
g.text: Ground support only; removed before flight with the RBF pin

g.title: J_EPS_UMB
g.text: EPS J13 (zone Z5): UMB_CHG via F5 1 A and D16 to PACK_P; PACK_N; UMB_VMON (100 k from BAT_F); UMB_SHUT

g.title: W11
g.text: M22759/33-24; charge pairs twisted (1+3, 2+4); 0.5 A ground charge on two wires per pole (14 mV); under the EPS, through the -Y deck slot and down the -Y wall strip

g.title: P_GSE
g.text: GSE cable: SWD probe (VTREF sense only), 3.3 V USB-UART referenced to VTREF, pin 13 jumpered to pin 1, WDT_DIS switch to VTREF; charger on 20/21 and 10/11, voltmeter on 9, AFE shutdown on 19
